name: Design Bakery
audience_feeling: That the work is real and inspectable — the reader can see the mechanism, not just the claim.
promise: Show how the work is built and what the evidence actually supports, so a reader can judge it without taking anything on faith.

preferred_terms.case study: a written account of one project
preferred_terms.evidence: an inspected artifact, test, or decision

good_examples: Study OS learns from where a student gets stuck, tries a different representation, and keeps the evidence tied to real learning sessions.
bad_examples: A revolutionary AI platform that seamlessly transforms learning for everyone.
